info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_E-Branch Operations Status API
info.description: The E-Branch Operations Status API provides real-time status updates related to various operations conducted through the e-branch banking channel. This API allows businesses to monitor active transactions, assess system performance, and ensure reliable customer service for users engaging with online banking functionalities. Typical consumers include customer service teams, operational managers, and financial analysts who need insights into transaction statuses for improved decision-making. Utilize this API to enhance user experience and maintain efficient banking operations.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of e-branch operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of e-branch operations, providing insights into operational availability and any potential issues that may be affecting service performance.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of specific e-branch operations. It is important to ensure that the request contains all necessary criteria to get an accurate status update.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status.

GetEbranchOperationsStatusRequest.description: Represents the request body for the specific branch operations status in the channel.
